title: Linux Operating System
content: Linux is a family of open-source Unix-like operating systems based on the Linux kernel. It was first released by Linus Torvalds in 1991. Linux distributions include Ubuntu Fedora Debian and Arch Linux. The Linux kernel manages hardware resources and provides essential services. Linux is widely used in servers cloud computing embedded systems and supercomputers. The command line interface provides powerful tools for system administration. Package managers like apt and yum handle software installation and dependency management.
